chapter: Georgie Auld, Hawkins and Los Angeles
title: San Diego with Red Callender and Teddy Edwards
summary: He forms a band for a San Diego promoter and enjoys being the leader.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing in Lionel Hampton's big band

blocks.x: So I went down to... I had Red Callender and Teddy Edwards...who else did I have...? A cat named Monk played drums, I think. So anyway, we went down to San Diego...
Had you met Red Callender and Teddy Edwards when you got out to the Coast?

Well, I knew Teddy from Detroit, because I saw him in Detroit. But I didn't know Red Callender, but somebody had told me he was a good bass player, so I called him up, and he said he'd be glad to make it. He put his hand in my pocket, you know, but he made it! So I said, "Okay"... He charged me a lot of money.
Who did you have playing piano?

A cat named Vernon Biddle. Anyway, we went down there and played, and I had a nice time, actually, being the bandleader and playing what I want to play, when I want to play it -- that was very nice, you know. I said, "Yeah, okay." So we stayed down there for about two weeks, and then we came back to Los Angeles.
